messages:
deploy-bot: Deploy finished: quickshift v2026.2 -> prod. Canary=5% on /v2/generate. Post-deploy smoke tasks queued. :rocket:

sara: kicking off a quick async synthetic against the canary group now (curl + small prompt).

smoke-bot: Synthetic run started (id=synth-2768-a). targets: /v2/generate (5%) across us-west-2, eu-west-1, ap-southeast-1. Expect ~10 checks per region.

sara: curl output snippet:
```
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
{"id":"resp_01","latency_ms":135} 
```
(US ok so far)

smoke-bot: Synthetic completed: 29/30 ok, 1 failure. Failure details: eu-west-1 /v2/generate?variant=quant -> 503 ServiceUnavailable, p95 latency for that route = 420ms (baseline 110ms).

priya: seeing p95 spike too in metrics dashboard for route /v2/generate?variant=quant. KV cache miss rate jumped ~6x around deploy timestamp. Could be a variant-specific kernel path.

jason: logs from inference-proxy show a burst of `prefetch` errors + a few OOM-ish retries on the quant variant handlers. Not a full host crash but retry loop triggered CB for that route.

ryan: @sara @priya quick question — is this canary limited to a small subset of customers? any sensitive traffic routed?

sara: yes, only 5% and not enterprise-tier routes. But the route is used by some EU test accounts.

priya: RCA hypothesis: quantized model variant introduces a slower kernel path on eu instances (different gpu driver patch level). Could be perf cliff causing request queueing -> 503s when CB hits.

jason: mitigation options: 1) roll back canary (full rollback to v2026.1), 2) pin the problematic route variant to v2026.1 via routing override, 3) scale up the canary pool in eu for short window.

ryan: prefer route pin (2) so we don't disrupt unrelated variants. Lower blast radius. If pin fixed, resume rollout.

sara: I can push a routing override. command:
```bash
./rbctl route-override set 
  --path "/v2/generate?variant=quant" 
  --target-version v2026.1 
  --reason "canary perf spike eu-west-1"
```
I'll apply now and tail smoke results.

deploy-bot: Route override applied: /v2/generate?variant=quant -> v2026.1 (scope: eu-west-1) by sara at 2768000300.

smoke-bot: Re-running synthetic for affected targets (synth-2768-b).

smoke-bot: Synthetic completed: 30/30 ok. eu-west-1 p95 now 115ms, 0/10 503s.

priya: looks clean. KV miss rate returning to baseline. My money is on driver/kernel mismatch + quant path regressing performance under certain sequence lengths.

jason: follow-up action items: 1) mark v2026.2 quant variant as blocked in model-catalog, 2) open infra ticket to check driver versions across eu pool, 3) run extended canary in apac/us with quant disabled until we verify.

ryan: agree. For rollout status: HOLD resume=manual. We'll re-evaluate after infra patch or a targeted perf patch for quant kernel.

sara: noted. I'll add deploy notes in the release thread and close the canary increment. Will leave the general canary (non-quant traffic) at 5% for now. Monitoring alert set for 30m. :white_check_mark:

jason: thanks all. Great quick triage. We'll reconvene if any additional failures pop up.
